title: Mouse press
use: At pointer button down
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Mouse release
use: At pointer button up
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Mouse click
use: A dry mechanical press and release, at activation
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Double click
use: Only when two real clicks occur
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Keyboard key
use: At a visible character insertion
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Typing
use: A demonstration burst; use individual keys for exact text timing
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Enter key
use: At submission by keyboard, never a mouse submit
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Backspace
use: At an actual text deletion
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Switch
use: At the checked or selected state change
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Drag pickup
use: Once when grabbing an object
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Drop
use: Once when the object is released in its destination
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Snap into place
use: At a visible alignment or snap point
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Pop or reveal
use: Optional emphasis on a new object appearing, not a mouse click
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Panel whoosh
use: With a meaningful moving panel or scene transition
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Loading starts
use: At the beginning of an actual waiting state
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Loading texture
use: Optional quiet loop while visibly loading; stop at resolution
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Success
use: When the result is visible and complete
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Warning
use: When a recoverable warning appears
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Error
use: When an action actually fails, not when it merely waits
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Notification
use: At a new notification or incoming message
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording

title: Undo or restore
use: At the visible reversal of the edit
provenance: Locally synthesized approximation, not a hardware recording
